args.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION calculate_csi(p_cntref character varying) RETURNS numeric AS $$DECLARE v_authenscore numeric; v_cntuniqscore numeric; v_convnatval numeric; v_mediaratio numeric; v_txtuniq numeric; BEGIN SELECT ma.authenscore INTO v_authenscore FROM moderationaction ma WHERE ma.macntref = p_cntref; SELECT cb.cntuniqscore, cb.mediaratio INTO v_cntuniqscore, v_mediaratio FROM contentbehavior cb WHERE cb.cntref = p_cntref; SELECT ma.convnatval, ma.txtuniq INTO v_convnatval, v_txtuniq FROM messaginganalysis ma WHERE ma.msgcntref = p_cntref; v_authenscore := COALESCE(v_authenscore, 0); v_cntuniqscore := COALESCE(v_cntuniqscore, 0); v_convnatval := COALESCE(v_convnatval, 0); v_mediaratio := COALESCE(v_mediaratio, 0); v_txtuniq := COALESCE(v_txtuniq, 0); RETURN 0.7 * (1 - (0.4 * (1 - v_cntuniqscore) + 0.3 * v_mediaratio + 0.3 * v_txtuniq)) + 0.3 * (0.3 * v_authenscore + 0.3 * v_cntuniqscore + 0.4 * v_convnatval); EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN RAISE WARNING 'Error calculating CSI for %: %', p_cntref, SQLERRM; RETURN NULL; END; $$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;
